title: Security Operations
description: Security Runtime Completion and Release Evidence slice, Work Package R. Transport/signing-key/message-authenticity event volume, worker security-event centralization health, and journal source lag -- built from the low-cardinality fl_security_events_total / fl_security_event_source_* metrics documented in docs/security-metrics.md and docs/security-event-source-health.md. This dashboard does not chart secure-aggregation activity (not implemented -- see docs/known-limitations.md).

panels.title: Security events rate by severity
panels.description: sum by (severity) (rate(fl_security_events_total[5m])). A sustained rise in CRITICAL/HIGH is the primary alerting signal this dashboard exists to surface.

panels.title: Security events rate by category and outcome
panels.description: sum by (category, outcome) (rate(fl_security_events_total[5m])). category is the coarse, fixed set (transport/worker_identity/worker_signing_key/signed_message/coordinator_task/administration/other), never the raw ~55-value event_type -- see docs/security-metrics.md's cardinality discipline.

panels.title: Event source lag (seconds since last accepted event/batch)
panels.description: fl_security_event_source_lag_seconds by source_service (go-api / coordinator / python-worker). The fixed staleness threshold (docs/security-event-source-health.md) is 120s -- a source crossing that line for an extended period indicates it has stopped reporting, not merely a quiet period.

panels.title: Event source record counts
panels.description: fl_security_event_source_records by source_service -- last-observed journal size per source, a monotonically-nondecreasing snapshot (not a rate).

panels.title: Worker security-event batch outcomes
panels.description: fl_security_event_source_batches{outcome="accepted"|"rejected"} -- a sustained rejected count above zero means a worker is producing batches the coordinator's SubmitWorkerSecurityEvents verification is rejecting (bad signature, replay, schema mismatch, etc).

panels.title: Distinct workers seen (coordinator source)
panels.description: fl_security_event_source_distinct_workers{source_service="coordinator"} -- an aggregate count only, never a list of worker IDs (see docs/security-event-source-health.md's explicit no-per-worker-label discipline).
